subject: POC success criteria & KPIs — Atlas Payments
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya.m@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria & KPIs — Atlas Payments

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial:

POC objective (what success looks like):
- Validate Redwood inference for Atlas Payments' transaction categorization & fraud signal enrichment pipeline at production scale, with acceptable latency and cost.

Proposed measurable success criteria (please confirm or adjust):
1) Latency: P95 < 200ms for end-to-end inference (request -> token response finish) under expected request size (avg 120 tokens).
2) Throughput: Sustained 100 req/s with target burst to 200 req/s during peak windows using the recommended Dedicated config (4x A10G-equivalent GPUs).
3) Cost: amortized cost/token <= $0.0005 when using 8-bit quantized variant and batching configurations.
4) Quality: 90%+ intent classification accuracy on your labeled test set (we'll run an automated regression) and manual spot-checks with a 4-point quality rubric (precision, recall, hallucination rate, business impact).

Timeline & ownership:
- Proposed POC window: Apr 12 — May 3 (3 weeks).
- Redwood owners: Jordan (sales, overall), Marissa (customer success / onboarding), Dev (solutions engineering / infra).
- Atlas owners: please confirm primary technical contact and decision maker (we discussed Carlos potentially).

Deliverables before POC start:
- Redwood to share POC onboarding checklist + test harness spec (attached).
- Atlas to provide sample traffic schema, a small labeled dataset for quality eval, and any IP/data handling constraints.

Next steps:
- Can you confirm the success criteria above (especially latency targets) and the proposed window?
- If ok, we'll send a short MPA (mutual action plan) and calendar invites for weekly checkpoints.

Attaching: redwood-poc-onboarding-checklist.pdf, poc-success-kpis-v2.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake

Hi Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — overall this looks good and we're excited to move forward. A few adjustments / asks from our side:

1) Latency: We'd like P95 <= 150ms if possible for our subset of real-time enrichment traffic. If that requires a different config, please call it out in the MPA.
2) Throughput: Can we size for 120 req/s sustained (expected peak 250 req/s) — we operate some short bursts around end-of-day settlement.
3) Data residency: All test data for this POC must remain in US regions only.
4) Security/compliance: please attach your SOC 2 report and the security questionnaire — our InfoSec will review. (Attached: atlas-security-questionnaire.pdf)

Technical contact: Carlos Medina (c.medina@atlas-payments.com) will be our infra/tech lead. Final decision maker for the pilot is me, with procurement loop-in to follow.

Weekly checkpoints sound good — Wed mornings (10am PT) would work for us.

We'll put together a small labeled sample (~2k rows) and a schema export by EOD Thu (Apr 8).

Confirming timeline: Apr 12 — May 3 OK from our side pending SOC2/MPA sign-off.

Thanks — Priya

Hi all — quick tech note and a short checklist so we can validate the targets you asked for (Priya):

1) To meet P95 <= 150ms we recommend the following baseline infra during the POC: 4x A10G-equivalent GPUs (dedicated), optimized kv-cache enabled, and dynamic batching with 50ms latency budget. We'll provide a pre-configured container image.

2) For throughput testing we'll use a synthetic harness that replays your sampled production traces (anonymized). Please provide a sample export (CSV or newline JSON) with schema for the following fields: transaction_id, timestamp, amount_cents, merchant_category, card_present_flag, and ground_truth_label. Prefer ~2k labeled rows for initial quality evaluation; we can scale up for load tests.

3) Security: we'll run in your US region and provide a signed SOC2 attestation. Any additional network constraints (e.g., IP allowlist) — please share.

Attached: test-harness-specs.md — contains the harness commands, exact payload shape, and example curl for replay.

I'll kick off a small smoke test as soon as we have the sample dataset. Happy to jump on a call with Carlos if needed.

— Dev
